integrity: Proved from an explicit differential basis and semilinear Cartier matrix, with a separate geometric analysis of the Frobenius-twisted rank-zero locus. Reproducible finite-field tests are embedded; independent mathematical assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to monic squarefree octics over algebraically closed characteristic-two fields and their smooth Kummer normalizations. It describes the reduced coefficient-space strata, not a moduli-stack scheme, Newton polygons, or full Ekedahl–Oort types. Literature priority is provisional; finite-field tests corroborate but do not independently prove the universal theorem.
title: Frobenius-quintic zero-rank locus for genus-seven cyclic trigonal curves
